challenge.method: Compare the visual cube layout and Table 1 with the Section 5 stack rule, including equal indentation and the end-of-section treatment.
challenge.results: The following row belongs to the body when its indentation exceeds the opener indentation. A row with equal or lesser indentation closes eligible structures, and section end is handled as indentation zero. The universal closing token is generated.

limitations: The layout described is a two-dimensional pictogram grid. The rule is not evidence about a text tokenizer, whitespace normalization, or other implementations.
